Tomato with Early Blight.symptoms: Concentric dark brown rings ('target board' spots) on older leaves starting from base, leaf yellowing, stem lesions and fruit rot.
Tomato with Early Blight.cultural_management: Remove and burn lower infected leaves; stake plants to improve aeration; maintain 2-year crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops.
Tomato with Early Blight.biological_control: Foliar spray of Trichoderma harzianum @ 5g/L or Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/L at early onset.
Tomato with Early Blight.chemical_control: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L; in severe cases, Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1 ml/L (Wait period: 3 days).
Tomato with Early Blight.official_source: ICAR-IIHR Bangalore IPM Bulletin & CIBRC Approved Label Claims

Tomato with Late Blight.symptoms: Water-soaked irregular pale green lesions on leaves turning purplish-brown rapidly, white fungal mold on underside during high humidity, rapid blighting of entire plant.
Tomato with Late Blight.cultural_management: Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; ensure wide spacing and clean bund drainage; destroy infected haulms immediately.
Tomato with Late Blight.biological_control: Prophylactic application of bio-formulation Trichoderma viride.
Tomato with Late Blight.chemical_control: Prophylactic: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L. Curative: Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 3 g/L or Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L.
Tomato with Late Blight.official_source: ICAR-CPRI Shimla & UAS Dharwad Plant Pathology Guidelines

Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.pathogen: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus (TYLCV - Begomovirus) transmitted by Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci)
Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.symptoms: Upward curling and cupping of leaflet margins, severe stunting of plants, yellowing between veins, flower drop with no fruit set.
Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.cultural_management: Erect yellow sticky traps (15-20 traps/acre) to monitor and mass-trap whiteflies; remove and destroy symptomatic early infected plants; plant border rows of maize or sorghum (3-4 rows) as physical barrier.
Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.biological_control: Spray Neem oil 1500 ppm @ 3-5 ml/L or Lecanicillium lecanii @ 5 g/L to suppress whitefly nymphs.
Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus.chemical_control: Spray Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.2 g/L or Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.4 ml/L to control vector whiteflies.

Tomato with Bacterial Spot.symptoms: Small (2-3 mm) dark brown, water-soaked circular to angular lesions on leaves, often surrounded by yellow halos, causing defoliation and blister-like scab fruit spots.
Tomato with Bacterial Spot.cultural_management: Use certified disease-free seeds; treat seeds with hot water (50°C for 25 min); avoid handling wet foliage.
Tomato with Bacterial Spot.biological_control: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/kg seed + foliar spray @ 5g/L.
Tomato with Bacterial Spot.chemical_control: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L mixed with Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L (1 g in 10 liters water) at 10-12 day intervals.

Corn (Maize) with Common Rust.symptoms: Golden-brown to cinnamon-brown powdery pustules (uredinia) scattered on both upper and lower leaf surfaces, becoming brownish-black as plant matures.
Corn (Maize) with Common Rust.cultural_management: Plant rust-resistant hybrids; destroy volunteer maize plants in surrounding fields.
Corn (Maize) with Common Rust.chemical_control: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1 ml/L at first appearance of pustules.
Corn (Maize) with Common Rust.official_source: ICAR-IIMR Ludhiana (Indian Institute of Maize Research)

Corn (Maize) with Northern Leaf Blight.symptoms: Long, elliptical, grayish-green or tan lesions (3 to 15 cm long) with distinctive cigar-shaped borders running parallel to leaf veins.
Corn (Maize) with Northern Leaf Blight.cultural_management: Deep summer plowing to bury crop residues; rotate with non-host crops like pulses or cotton.
Corn (Maize) with Northern Leaf Blight.biological_control: Seed treatment with Trichoderma asperellum @ 6g/kg seed.
Corn (Maize) with Northern Leaf Blight.chemical_control: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L at knee-high and tasseling stages.
Corn (Maize) with Northern Leaf Blight.official_source: ICAR-IIMR & UAS Raichur Maize Pathology Advisory

Potato with Early Blight.symptoms: Dark brown circular spots with concentric rings on lower leaves, spread upward; leaves wither and dry like parchment.
Potato with Early Blight.cultural_management: Maintain balanced nitrogen fertilization (excess or deficiency aggravates disease); avoid sprinkler irrigation in evenings.
Potato with Early Blight.chemical_control: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Fenamidone 10% + Mancozeb 50% WG @ 2.5 g/L.

Potato with Late Blight.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions expanding rapidly into black blighted patches with white downy growth on undersides during cool, cloudy, humid weather.
Potato with Late Blight.cultural_management: Plant certified seed tubers; dehaulm crop 10-12 days before harvesting to prevent tuber infection.
Potato with Late Blight.chemical_control: Prophylactic: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L. Contact + Systemic: Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1 g/L + Mancozeb 2 g/L.
Potato with Late Blight.official_source: ICAR-CPRI Shimla National Late Blight Advisory

Apple Scab.symptoms: Olive-green, velvety, circular spots with feathery margins on leaves and fruits, later becoming dark brown and corky.
Apple Scab.cultural_management: Rake and destroy fallen leaves in autumn; apply 5% Urea spray on orchard floor before leaf fall to accelerate decomposition of overwintering perithecia.
Apple Scab.chemical_control: Pre-bloom spray of Dodine 65% WP @ 0.75 g/L; post-bloom spray of Difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.3 ml/L or Captan 50% WP @ 2 g/L.
Apple Scab.official_source: ICAR-CITH Srinagar (Central Institute of Temperate Horticulture)

Grape with Black Rot.symptoms: Reddish-brown circular spots on leaves; berries shrivel into hard, black, wrinkled mummies covered with tiny black pycnidia.
Grape with Black Rot.cultural_management: Prune and destroy infected mummified berries and canes during winter; maintain open canopy for sun exposure and ventilation.
Grape with Black Rot.chemical_control: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1 ml/L or Kresoxim-methyl 44.3% SC @ 0.7 ml/L.
Grape with Black Rot.official_source: ICAR-NRC Grapes Pune (National Research Centre for Grapes)
